newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fruit and vegetable reform finalised.
newsitem.headline: Fruit and vegetable reform finalised.

text.p: The Special Committee on Agriculture this week finalised a reform of the fresh and processed fruit and vegetgable sector, EU officials said on Thursday.
Farm ministers reached political agreement in July but some details, notably a budgetary neutral increase in the Portuguese quota for processed tomatoes still had to be defined.

A solution was found by which aid for tomato concentrate will be cut by 5.37 percent for all EU producers. But Portuguese and French processors can claim a pro-rata reimbursement if they fail to fill their production quotas.
The reform is aimed at improving production quality and encouraging farmers to sell their produce on the market instead of to intervention stores.
The reform regulation will be adopted as an "A" point without discussion at a forthcoming EU council.
